Create and maintain product and technical documentation, including requirements, workflows, release notes, technical guidance, FAQs, and runbooks, to support stakeholders and platform adoption. Good understanding of AI/ML concepts and the model lifecycle, including data preparation, feature engineering, model development, inference, deployment, and monitoring. Understanding of Generative AI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG, embeddings, evaluation approaches, and agentic AI. Hands-on experience with Python and/or SQL for data analysis, automation, prototyping, or AI/ML use cases. Exposure to Databricks and/or cloud environments AI/ML workloads. Understanding of large-scale data processing concepts, including batch and real-time/streaming processing in support of AI/ML use cases. Experience working with cross-functional teams to launch and support technical products or AI/ML platform capabilities within complex organizations. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills. title: Technical Analyst
description: Shape the future of work in complex industries. At Falkor, we help some of the world's most complex industries operate with greater clarity, confidence, and control. Built on more than 200 years of KONGSBERG industrial heritage, our industrial intelligence platform connects people, systems, and workflows across energy, processing, power, renewables, and other heavy-asset industries. We turn complexity into clarity and data into decisions, helping organizations improve safety, efficiency, and performance across the asset lifecycle. As industries evolve, we're building the technology that helps people see further, decide faster, and operate with confidence. The Opportunity Falkor is seeking a Technical Analyst to join the Customer Support team. This hands-on role is suited to candidates with 0–4 years of experience in application, technical, or product support and troubleshooting for internal or external customers. You will install, configure, implement, and support real-time systems and applications for the oil and gas industry. Working directly with customers and collaborating with internal teams, you will troubleshoot technical issues, support reliable application operation, and deliver timely, customer-focused resolutions. The role requires rotational day and night shifts in India and travel to client offices when required. Every Technical Analyst will have the opportunity to learn and support all products across Falkor’s portfolio, including SiteCom, LedaFlow, K-Spice, Falkor Platform, and Falkor Surface. Primary product assignments will be aligned to each analyst’s best fit, considering their technical strengths, domain knowledge, and interests, while maintaining opportunities to build expertise and contribute across the portfolio. SiteCom: Real-time drilling data management. LedaFlow: Transient multiphase flow simulation and flow assurance in wells and pipelines. K-Spice: Dynamic process simulation for engineering design, verification, optimisation, and operator training. Falkor Platform: Industrial data integration and contextualisation, providing a connected foundation for applications, simulation, and AI. Falkor Surface: A shared operational workspace connecting people, data, simulation, and AI agents for collaboration and decision support. What You'll Do: Key Responsibilities- Customer Support and Application Operations Install, configure, implement, and support Falkor applications across real-time drilling data, flow and process simulation, industrial data integration, and operational collaboration, in line with assigned responsibilities. Handle customer support requests over email and phone, troubleshooting and resolving issues on installed systems in a timely manner. Use knowledge of each customer’s environment to deliver high-quality incident resolution, with a focus on identifying root causes. SiteCom: Support real-time drilling data availability and WITSML data exchange; investigate data access, connectivity, and data-quality issues affecting customer workflows. LedaFlow: Assist users with application setup, simulation case execution, and access to results for multiphase flow and flow-assurance studies; capture reproducible issues for specialist investigation. K-Spice: Support application configuration and the operation of dynamic process simulation and operator-training environments; investigate simulation execution and integration issues with the relevant specialists. Falkor Platform: Support data-source connectivity, ingestion, contextualisation, and access to industrial data; investigate reported data availability and integration issues. Falkor Surface: Help users access and navigate operational workspaces, search and visualise asset information, and use collaboration features; troubleshoot access, display, and workflow issues. Customer Enablement and Delivery Support Work with clients to configure and support SiteCom real-time data workflows and WITSML integrations for drilling environments. Support deployment and configuration of applicable Falkor applications. Collaborate with customers and internal teams to clarify technical requirements and resolve application issues. Assist customers with onboarding and initial setup across simulation, data-platform, and operational-workspace products, coordinating with delivery and product specialists as required. Help validate data connections and access in Falkor Platform, asset information and workspace configuration in Falkor Surface, and simulation environment readiness for LedaFlow and K-Spice. SLA Management and Support Operations Manage support requests in line with defined service-level agreements, incident priorities, and support procedures. Provide clear, timely updates to customers throughout troubleshooting and resolution. Maintain accurate incident records, troubleshooting notes, and shift handovers to support continuity of service. Technical Troubleshooting and Escalation Investigate application, Windows Server, network connectivity, configuration, and data-related issues across supported customer environments, distinguishing technical faults from matters requiring product or domain expertise. Apply knowledge of SQL, NoSQL, and flat-file databases to investigate issues in supported customer environments. Escalate complex issues to the appropriate internal teams with relevant context, diagnostic information, and troubleshooting steps already completed. Collect product-relevant diagnostics, such as SiteCom data-flow examples, LedaFlow and K-Spice simulation cases and execution logs, Falkor Platform ingestion and integration details, and Falkor Surface reproduction steps and affected views. Investigate automated alerts received for issues lying with the data quality, pipelines, asset and/or system health. Coordinate with product and domain specialists on simulation-model behaviour, flow-assurance questions, process-engineering issues, and complex data or workflow configurations; validate fixes and workarounds before confirming resolution. Knowledge Management and Continuous Improvement Document troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and root cause findings for reuse by the support team. Identify recurring issues and contribute to improvements in support documentation and processes. Build working knowledge across SiteCom, LedaFlow, K-Spice, Falkor Platform, and Falkor Surface through product learning and cross-team knowledge sharing, while developing deeper expertise in best-fit product assignments. Maintain product-specific troubleshooting guides covering recurring data-flow, simulation execution, integration, access, and workspace issues. Shift-Based Support Coverage Work rotational shifts in alignment with Customer Support coverage requirements and business needs. Provide weekend coverage when assigned, ensuring timely handovers and continuity of service. Provide clear handovers identifying the affected product, customer impact, troubleshooting completed, outstanding actions, and any specialist escalation needed to maintain continuity across shifts. Travel to client offices when required and work effectively with customers and colleagues across cultures. What We're Looking For: 0–2 years of experience in application, technical, or product support, including troubleshooting for internal or external customers over email and phone. Bachelor’s degree in petroleum engineering or computer science. Experience deploying, configuring, or supporting .NET applications or software on staging and production servers. Windows Server system administration experience and knowledge of network communication solutions. Knowledge of well construction processes, drilling workflows, drilling performance analytics, and standard operating practices in the oil and gas industry. Working knowledge and experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, and JSON. A proactive, customer-friendly approach, a commitment to on-time delivery, and strong troubleshooting skills. Ability to work both independently and as part of a team, including with people from different cultures. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Willingness to work rotational day and night shifts in India and travel to client offices when required. Desirable Experience Familiarity with WITSML or WITS. Experience working on a drilling rig; beneficial but not mandatory. Experience administering SaaS solutions on Microsoft Azure. Knowledge of the software development life cycle (SDLC). Success Measures Technical support issues are resolved promptly and effectively, with clear customer communication. Root cause findings and resolutions are documented accurately and made available for reuse. Deployments, configurations, and customer-specific solutions meet agreed requirements. Shift handovers and support records enable continuity of service. Recurring issues are identified and support knowledge and processes improve over time. Why join Falkor? You'll be joining a global technology company helping to redefine how complex industries operate. At Falkor, you'll have the opportunity to: Work on meaningful challenges with real-world impact Collaborate with talented colleagues across technology and industry domains Learn from experts in software, engineering, operations, and digital transformation Grow your career in a business that is expanding globally Help shape technology that expands human capability in complex industries We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, included, and able to do their best work. About Falkor Falkor is a KONGSBERG company that enables organizations in heavy-asset industries to expand human capability and redefine how assets are designed, operated, and optimized across their lifecycle. By connecting people, systems, and workflows, Falkor's industrial intelligence platform turns complexity into clarity and data into decisions, helping leading organizations improve safety, efficiency, and performance. Ready to apply? If you're excited about solving complex challenges and making an impact through technology, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today with your resume.
